content.short: Navi Protocol is the leading lending and borrowing platform on Sui, offering modular DeFi and leverage vaults.
content.description:
Navi Protocol is the definitive decentralized liquidity and money market platform built natively on the Sui blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency and security, the protocol allows users to supply various digital assets to earn interest and borrow against them with sub-second finality. Navi leverages the high throughput and safety of Sui's Move programming language to provide a professional-grade borrowing experience, including specialized isolation markets for volatile assets and automated leverage vaults.

Powered by the NAVX token, the protocol serves as a central hub for the Sui DeFi ecosystem, providing the essential liquidity infrastructure needed for project bootstrapping and user engagement. Navi focuses on institutional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, empowering participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with ease. Through its commitment to innovation and community-driven growth, Navi Protocol has become a primary pillar of the decentralized economy on the Sui network.
